suggested strategies.Length of Stay: Optimize discharge planning and enhance post-discharge support to potentially reduce the Length of Stay from 4 days to a shorter duration without compromising care quality.
suggested strategies.Type of Admission: Encourage and enhance pre-admission planning and outpatient management to reduce emergency admissions when possible, focusing on preventive care and early interventions.
suggested strategies.CCSR Procedure Code: Evaluate the necessity and frequency of ADM017 procedures to ensure they are essential and explore alternative methods or dosing schedules that maintain efficacy while reducing frequency.
suggested strategies.Total Charges: Negotiate better rates with private insurers and Medicare, and implement cost-saving measures in supply and resource utilization to reduce overall charges.
suggested strategies.Emergency Department Indicator: Strengthen outpatient and primary care follow-up to decrease unnecessary emergency department visits, thereby reducing associated high costs.
